name: Tests flipping back and forth don't make Boop's mood flail
case: Within a couple of minutes the agent's tests fail, pass, fail, pass, fail and pass again, twenty seconds apart. Boop reacts to what stands out, but its mood doesn't flip with every result: once it has moved it holds that mood for at least a minute rather than bouncing straight back to the one it just left.
gap: The mood question's options say annoyed and determined are for a failed check and proud or engaged for a pass after failing, and Jev follows each result over the MOOD file's 'stays through a failed check', so the mood can follow the flips once its first minute is up. Proposed fix: reword those options, or hold a new mood for a minute in the mood action (the owner chose pacing by steering only, D5).
why: The owner's liveliness brief (2026-09-28): mood changes are progressive and don't flail. plan/steering/guide.md: a mood holds while HISTORY says it's under a minute old, unless something bigger happens
